#### Maintenance and Contributions

The handbook follows a single-maintainer model: the maintainer is the author and final approver of all changes. Substantive changes, including the maintainer’s own, also require an independent review record before approval; the reviewer must not be the author.

- **Minor corrections** — typographical errors, broken references, formatting — are integrated directly.
- **Substantive changes**, including the maintainer’s own, are published as proposals open for comments for at least seven days and independently reviewed before approval.
- **Contributions** from other architects are welcome as proposals with a short rationale and supporting sources. Contributions are accepted under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

Each release is recorded in the version history. A minor version adds or corrects content without changing the structure; a major version changes the structure or the reference scenario. Statements that depend on an external standard name that standard and its version, so that they can be rechecked when the standard changes.
